name: dsh-native-daily
description: DSH trusted-local daily harness: two extension packages (dsh-daily-work, dsh-ipython) plus the qualification plane. NOT an official @deepseek-ai package.
//: WHY A ROOT package.json EXISTS AT ALL (F10).
Before this file, the repository had NO root manifest, so there was no single
entry point to cite for the typecheck and readers reached for whatever was
obvious: `tsc -p tsconfig.json`, which excludes src/**/*.test.ts and therefore
exits 0 with or without a test file present. That is the F10 / ID-05 false pass.
The package set is deliberately NOT a pnpm workspace. The two packages are
consumed by the DSH profile resolver through `link:` targets (see
profiles/daily-candidate/package.json) and are built by their own
`link-all-dsh.ps1` junction farms; turning them into workspace members would
change how they resolve `@deepseek-ai/*` and would be a build-identity change
made to satisfy a typecheck gate. The gate does not need it: it needs ONE
command, and that command is `pnpm typecheck` -> helpers/typecheck.mjs.
There are no dependencies here on purpose. The script uses only Node builtins,
so `pnpm typecheck` works from a clean clone with nothing installed, which is
what makes it a usable gate rather than a statement about one machine.
